title: 清水混凝土模板與澆置~Architectural exposed-concrete formwork and casting
focus: 讓結構混凝土一次成形即為完成面：模板分割、面板與脫模劑、配比一致性、澆置與樣板驗收~Making structural concrete its own finished surface at one casting: panel layout, facing and release agent, mix consistency, placing and mock-up acceptance
summary: 清水混凝土的表面就是建築完成面，不能事後粉刷遮蓋，因此模板分割、繫桿孔排列、面板材料、脫模劑、配比與骨材一致性、澆置速度與振搗、樣板牆與驗收距離都必須在施工前定案。本課以安藤忠雄的光之教會與路易斯．康的沙克研究所為例，並以 ACI 347.3R 的成形面等級 CSC1 至 CSC4 與 ACI 301 第 6 節建築混凝土為框架，說明清水混凝土從設計意圖到長期維護的工程判斷。~In exposed architectural concrete the surface is the finished building face and cannot be covered later, so panel layout, tie-hole pattern, facing material, release agent, mix and aggregate consistency, placing rate and vibration, mock-ups and viewing distance must all be settled before casting. Using Tadao Ando's Church of the Light and Louis Kahn's Salk Institute, framed by the ACI 347.3R formed-surface categories CSC1 to CSC4 and ACI 301 Section 6 Architectural Concrete, the course explains engineering judgement from design intent to long-term maintenance.

units.title: 清水混凝土的性能目標與等級~Performance targets and surface categories
units.mechanism: 清水混凝土的第一個工程問題是「要多好」。ACI 347.3R 把成形混凝土表面分為 CSC1 到 CSC4 四級：CSC1 用於地下室牆等不重視外觀的位置，CSC3 可用於一般商業建築外牆，CSC4 則用於紀念性或地標建築；每一級對模板面材、表面孔洞比例與顏色均勻度的要求不同。ACI 301 第 6 節建築混凝土只有在契約文件指定時才適用，所以設計者必須在圖說中明確寫出哪些面是清水面、要求哪一級，否則承包商只會按一般結構混凝土施作。等級越高，模板、配比、人力與樣板成本都越高。~The first engineering question for exposed concrete is how good it must be. ACI 347.3R divides formed concrete surfaces into four categories, CSC1 to CSC4: CSC1 for places such as basement walls where appearance matters little, CSC3 for ordinary commercial exteriors and CSC4 for monumental or landmark structures, each with different requirements for form facing, surface void ratio and colour uniformity. ACI 301 Section 6 Architectural Concrete applies only when the contract documents designate it, so the designer must state explicitly which faces are exposed and to what category, or the contractor will simply build ordinary structural concrete. Higher categories cost more in formwork, mix control, labour and mock-ups.
units.model: 表面孔洞比例 = 孔洞總面積/檢查面積。在 0.5 m×0.5 m = 250,000 mm² 的檢查框內量到孔洞總面積 400 mm²，比例 = 400/250,000 = 0.16%；若規格要求 ≤ 0.3%（教學假設值）則合格，若同一框內有一個直徑 25 mm 的大孔（約 491 mm²）就會超出。數值為教學假設，實際限值依規範表格與契約。~Surface void ratio = total void area/inspected area. In a 0.5 m×0.5 m frame of 250,000 mm², a measured void area of 400 mm² gives 400/250,000 = 0.16%; against an assumed limit of 0.3% it passes, but a single 25 mm diameter bughole of about 491 mm² in the same frame would exceed it. Values are teaching assumptions; actual limits come from the code tables and the contract.
units.verify: 在設計圖說中以立面圖標示每一個清水面的等級與觀看條件，並在施工前由業主、建築師與承包商共同確認；驗收時以固定尺寸的檢查框隨機抽取位置，量測孔洞比例並與規定值及樣板牆比較。~Mark each exposed face's category and viewing conditions on elevations in the design documents and confirm them jointly with owner, architect and contractor before work starts; at acceptance place a fixed-size inspection frame at random locations, measure the void ratio and compare it with the specified value and the mock-up.
units.failure: 圖說只寫「清水混凝土」而未指定等級與驗收方法，完工後業主以地標級標準要求、承包商以一般結構標準施作，雙方對孔洞與色差爭執不下，最後只能大面積修補或塗裝，失去清水的意義。~Drawings that say only exposed concrete without a category or acceptance method lead the owner to expect landmark quality while the contractor builds to ordinary structural standards, and the two sides argue over voids and colour until extensive patching or painting defeats the purpose of exposed concrete.
units.misconception: 清水混凝土就是不粉刷的普通混凝土，不需要特別的規格。~Exposed concrete is just ordinary concrete left unpainted and needs no special specification.
units.practice: 在契約中引用 ACI 301 第 6 節或對應規範，逐面指定 ACI 347.3R 等級、孔洞比例、色差與平整度要求，以及樣板牆與觀看距離；這些要求要在投標前提供，讓承包商能正確估價。~Cite ACI 301 Section 6 or an equivalent in the contract, specify ACI 347.3R category, void ratio, colour and flatness face by face, along with the mock-up and viewing distance, and issue these before tender so contractors can price correctly.

units.anchor: 模板分割與繫桿孔~Panel layout and tie holes
units.title: 模板分割、拼縫與繫桿孔排列~Panel layout, joints and tie-hole pattern
units.mechanism: 在清水混凝土中，模板拼縫與繫桿孔不是缺陷，而是建築語彙：它們的位置、間距與對齊方式會永久留在表面上。安藤忠雄的作品常以約 910×1,820 mm 的模板與規則排列的繫桿孔構成立面節奏，路易斯．康在沙克研究所也讓模板接縫與繫桿孔成為表面的秩序。因此模板分割必須在建築設計階段與牆長、開口、樓層高度與轉角一起決定，並把繫桿孔放在面板上對稱的位置；若牆長不是面板寬度的整數倍，就會出現難看的窄條板。~In exposed concrete, form joints and tie holes are not defects but architectural vocabulary: their position, spacing and alignment stay on the surface permanently. Tadao Ando's work often uses forms of about 910×1,820 mm with regularly spaced tie holes to give elevations their rhythm, and Louis Kahn at the Salk Institute likewise let form joints and tie holes order the surface. Panel layout must therefore be settled at architectural design stage together with wall lengths, openings, storey heights and corners, with tie holes placed symmetrically on each panel; if a wall length is not a whole multiple of the panel width, an awkward narrow filler panel appears.
units.model: 牆長 17.5 m、面板寬 0.91 m 時需要 17.5/0.91 ≈ 19.2 片，不是整數。可選擇：改用 19 片、每片約 17.5/19 ≈ 0.921 m 的訂製寬度，或把牆長調為 19×0.91 = 17.29 m 或 20×0.91 = 18.2 m。牆高 3 片×1.82 m = 5.46 m，每片 6 個繫桿孔，19×3 = 57 片共 342 個繫桿孔。數值為教學假設。~A 17.5 m wall with 0.91 m panels needs 17.5/0.91 ≈ 19.2 panels, not a whole number. Options: 19 custom panels of about 17.5/19 ≈ 0.921 m, or adjusting the wall to 19×0.91 = 17.29 m or 20×0.91 = 18.2 m. Three panels of 1.82 m make 5.46 m of height; with 6 tie holes per panel, 19×3 = 57 panels carry 342 tie holes. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 以立面展開圖繪出每一道牆的面板分割、拼縫、繫桿孔與施工縫位置，並與開口、轉角、樓板邊緣對齊檢查；模板加工前由建築師簽認展開圖，現場組模後以捲尺與雷射抽查拼縫與繫桿孔位置。~Draw developed elevations of every wall showing panel layout, joints, tie holes and construction joints, checking alignment with openings, corners and slab edges; have the architect sign the developed elevations before forms are made, and spot-check joint and tie-hole positions on site with tape and laser after assembly.
units.failure: 模板分割在現場臨時決定，牆端出現 200 mm 的窄條板，繫桿孔在轉角兩側無法對齊，施工縫位置與拼縫錯開形成雜亂的水平線，整面清水牆的秩序被破壞且無法修正。~Deciding the layout on site leaves a 200 mm filler strip at the wall end, tie holes that cannot line up on either side of a corner, and construction joints offset from panel joints that form messy horizontal lines, destroying the order of the whole exposed wall beyond correction.
units.misconception: 模板拼縫與繫桿孔只是施工痕跡，交給工地自行安排即可。~Form joints and tie holes are just construction marks that the site can arrange as it likes.
units.practice: 把模板分割展開圖列為建築設計圖的一部分，施工縫、繫桿孔與拼縫的位置與構造詳圖（例如倒角、凹槽、繫桿錐形套）都要在開工前定案；任何現場調整須經建築師書面同意。~Make the developed formwork elevations part of the architectural drawings, and settle construction joints, tie holes and joint details such as chamfers, reveals and tie cones before work starts; any site adjustment needs the architect's written approval.

units.anchor: 面板材料與脫模劑~Facing material and release agent
units.title: 模板面材、脫模劑與表面顏色~Form facing, release agent and surface colour
units.mechanism: 混凝土表面會忠實複製模板面材的質感與吸水性：覆膜合板得到光滑均勻的表面，未處理木板留下木紋，吸水性不同的面板會讓表層水灰比不同而產生色差。ACI 347.3R 把模板面材特性列為成形面等級的三大分類之一。脫模劑塗太多會流淌並在表面留下深色斑痕或孔洞，塗太少則混凝土黏模；不同廠牌或批次的脫模劑也可能造成顏色差異。面材重複使用時表面磨損、吸水性改變，也會逐次改變混凝土顏色，所以高等級清水面要限制面材使用次數。~Concrete faithfully reproduces the texture and absorbency of the form facing: film-faced plywood gives a smooth, even surface, untreated boards leave wood grain, and facings of different absorbency change the surface water–cement ratio and cause colour differences. ACI 347.3R lists form-facing characteristics as one of its three surface-finish categories. Too much release agent runs and leaves dark stains or bugholes, too little lets concrete stick; different brands or batches of release agent can also change colour. Reused facings wear and change absorbency, gradually altering colour from use to use, so higher categories limit how many times a facing may be used.
units.model: 脫模劑用量若為 1 L/40 m²，1,000 m² 模板需 25 L，現場應以量杯或噴霧量控制而非目測。面材使用次數：清水牆總面積 2,400 m²、一套模板 400 m² 需翻用 2,400/400 = 6 次；若規格限定面材最多使用 4 次，需準備 6/4 = 1.5 套，即約 600 m² 面材。數值為教學假設。~At 1 L of release agent per 40 m², 1,000 m² of form needs 25 L, controlled by measured spray rather than by eye. Facing reuse: 2,400 m² of exposed wall with a 400 m² form set means 2,400/400 = 6 uses; if the specification allows a facing to be used at most 4 times, 6/4 = 1.5 sets, about 600 m² of facing, are needed. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 在樣板牆上試驗選定的面材與脫模劑組合，記錄用量與施作方式；施工中每次組模前檢查面材的損傷、修補與使用次數標記，並抽查脫模劑塗佈是否均勻，有流淌的面板須擦拭後才可合模。~Trial the chosen facing and release agent on the mock-up, recording dosage and application; before every assembly inspect facings for damage, repairs and use-count marks, spot-check that release agent is even, and wipe any panel with runs before closing the form.
units.failure: 同一面牆混用新舊面材，新面板吸水多，牆面出現與面板分割相同的明暗格子；脫模劑過量在下方積聚，牆腳一帶出現深色斑塊與密集小孔，無法以清洗去除。~Mixing new and used facings on one wall makes the more absorbent new panels show as a chequerboard of light and dark matching the panel layout; excess release agent pooling at the bottom leaves dark patches and dense small voids at the wall base that cannot be washed off.
units.misconception: 脫模劑塗得越多越好，可以保證拆模後表面光滑。~The more release agent the better; it guarantees a smooth surface after stripping.
units.practice: 規格中指定面材種類、使用次數上限與修補方式，以及脫模劑廠牌、用量與施作方法；同一可見面應使用同一批面材與同一批脫模劑，並在面板背面標記使用次數。~Specify facing type, maximum uses and repair method, and release-agent brand, dosage and application in the specification; use one batch of facing and one batch of release agent for each visible face, and mark use counts on the back of each panel.

units.anchor: 配比與材料一致性~Mix and material consistency
units.title: 配比、單一材料來源與色差控制~Mix design, single-source materials and colour control
units.mechanism: 清水混凝土的顏色由水泥、礦物摻料、細骨材的顏色與表層水灰比共同決定，所以整個工程應使用同一水泥廠、同一摻料來源與同一砂石來源，避免批次變化。沙克研究所的混凝土採用含火山灰的配比，產生偏暖的色調，康並在地下室以不同顏色的試驗牆比較配比；這說明配比本身就是外觀設計的一部分。最常被忽視的變數是骨材含水率：砂的含水率變動會改變實際用水量，表層水灰比升高時顏色變淺且孔洞增加。~The colour of exposed concrete comes from the cement, supplementary materials, fine aggregate and surface water–cement ratio together, so the whole job should use one cement plant, one supplementary-material source and one aggregate source to avoid batch variation. The Salk Institute used a mix containing volcanic ash that gives a warm tone, and Kahn compared mixes in differently coloured trial walls in the basement, showing that the mix itself is part of the visual design. The most overlooked variable is aggregate moisture: changes in sand moisture alter the actual water content, and a higher surface water–cement ratio lightens colour and increases voids.
units.model: 細骨材 800 kg/m³、含水率比假設高 1%，等於多加 8 L 水；水泥 350 kg/m³ 時水灰比由 0.45 變為 0.45 + 8/350 ≈ 0.473，增加約 0.023，足以在相鄰兩車之間造成可見色差。數值為教學假設。~With 800 kg/m³ of fine aggregate, moisture 1% above the assumed value adds 8 L of water; with 350 kg/m³ of cement the water–cement ratio rises from 0.45 to 0.45 + 8/350 ≈ 0.473, about 0.023 more, enough to cause a visible colour difference between adjacent truckloads. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 預拌廠以含水率感測器或每班烘乾試驗即時修正用水量，並記錄每車的配比、含水率與出廠時間；工地每車檢查坍度或坍流度與溫度，與樣板牆使用的配比紀錄比對，偏離範圍的車次退回。~The batch plant corrects water in real time with moisture probes or oven-dry tests each shift and records mix, moisture and dispatch time for every truck; on site check slump or slump flow and temperature for every truck against the mock-up mix record and reject trucks outside the range.
units.failure: 工程中途水泥廠更換或砂石來源改變，新舊混凝土交界出現明顯色帶；夏季砂料含水率波動而預拌廠未修正，同一面牆上下層顏色不同，修補無法消除。~Changing cement plant or aggregate source mid-job leaves a clear colour band where old and new concrete meet; summer swings in sand moisture not corrected at the plant give upper and lower lifts of one wall different colours that no repair can remove.
units.misconception: 只要強度等級相同，不同預拌廠的混凝土在外觀上沒有差別。~If the strength grade is the same, concrete from different plants looks the same.
units.practice: 清水混凝土的配比、水泥與骨材來源應在樣板牆核定後鎖定，供應契約中規定材料庫存與不可替換條款；任何變更都要重做樣板並經建築師同意。~Lock the mix, cement and aggregate sources once the mock-up is approved, require stockpiles and no-substitution clauses in the supply contract, and redo the mock-up with the architect's approval for any change.

units.anchor: 模板勁度與拼縫止漏~Form stiffness and joint sealing
units.title: 模板勁度、拼縫密封與漏漿痕~Form stiffness, joint sealing and grout-loss marks
units.mechanism: 清水面要平整、拼縫要乾淨，模板必須夠剛且密封良好。新鮮混凝土的側壓使面板在支撐間撓曲，撓曲量若超過肉眼在斜光下可辨識的程度，牆面就會出現波浪；拼縫若有縫隙，水泥漿在壓力下從縫隙流失，留下砂紋、深色漏漿痕或粗糙的蜂窩帶。因此清水模板常比結構模板有更密的背楞、更厚的面板，拼縫以密封條或膠帶處理，牆角與施工縫以倒角或凹槽把無法避免的接縫變成刻意的線條。~For a flat face and clean joints, forms must be stiff and well sealed. Fresh-concrete pressure bends facings between supports, and if deflection exceeds what the eye detects in raking light the wall shows waves; any gap at a joint lets paste escape under pressure, leaving sand streaks, dark grout-loss lines or rough honeycomb bands. Exposed-concrete forms therefore often have closer studs and thicker facings than structural forms, joints sealed with gaskets or tape, and chamfers or reveals at corners and construction joints that turn unavoidable joints into deliberate lines.
units.model: 21 mm 合板、E = 7,000 MPa，每 mm 寬 I = 21³/12 ≈ 772 mm⁴；側壓 50 kPa（0.05 N/mm²）、背楞間距 300 mm 時 δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) ≈ 0.98 mm ≈ L/307。若要求 L/400，背楞間距須 ≤ 約 281 mm；取 250 mm 時 δ ≈ 0.47 mm（約 L/531）。數值為教學假設。~For 21 mm plywood with E = 7,000 MPa, I per mm width = 21³/12 ≈ 772 mm⁴; at 50 kPa (0.05 N/mm²) with studs at 300 mm, δ = 5wL⁴/(384EI) ≈ 0.98 mm ≈ L/307. Meeting L/400 needs stud spacing ≤ about 281 mm; at 250 mm δ ≈ 0.47 mm, about L/531. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 模板計算書須列出設計側壓、面板與背楞的撓度限值；組模後以直尺與燈光斜照檢查面板平整，拼縫以塞尺確認間隙並檢查密封材；澆置中派人在模板外側巡視漏漿，發現時立即處理。~The formwork calculations must state design pressure and deflection limits for facings and studs; after assembly check flatness with a straightedge and raking light, gauge joint gaps with feelers and inspect seals; during placing have someone patrol the outside of the forms for paste leaks and deal with them at once.
units.failure: 為節省材料放寬背楞間距，拆模後在斜光下牆面出現規則的波浪；拼縫未密封，每一道拼縫兩側都有砂紋與深色漏漿線，牆腳因壓力最大而出現連續蜂窩帶。~Widening stud spacing to save material leaves regular waves visible in raking light after stripping; unsealed joints leave sand streaks and dark leak lines along every joint, and the wall base, where pressure is greatest, shows a continuous honeycomb band.
units.misconception: 清水模板只要表面光滑就好，背楞間距照一般結構模板即可。~Exposed-concrete forms only need a smooth facing; stud spacing can follow ordinary structural forms.
units.practice: 清水模板的撓度限值、拼縫密封方式與倒角凹槽詳圖要寫入模板設計規範，並由模板設計者出具計算書；第一次使用的模板系統必須先在樣板牆上驗證。~Write deflection limits, joint-sealing methods and chamfer and reveal details for exposed-concrete forms into the formwork specification, with calculations from the formwork designer, and prove any formwork system on the mock-up before first use.

units.anchor: 澆置速度與振搗控制~Placing rate and vibration control
units.title: 澆置上升速度、分層與振搗~Rate of rise, layering and vibration
units.mechanism: 清水牆的澆置要控制「上升速度」，也就是單位時間內混凝土在模板中升高的高度；它同時決定模板側壓、分層結合與表面氣泡。上升太快時側壓接近液壓，模板撓曲與漏漿增加，下層混凝土也來不及排出氣泡；太慢則兩層之間可能形成顏色不同的層線。振搗要讓氣泡沿模板面上升排出，但過度振搗會使漿體上浮、骨材下沉，造成上下顏色不同；振動棒碰觸模板面會在表面留下磨痕。ACI 347.3R 把表面孔洞比例作為成形面等級的分類依據之一，振搗正是控制孔洞的關鍵。~Placing exposed walls means controlling the rate of rise, how fast concrete climbs in the form, which governs form pressure, bonding between layers and surface bubbles. Too fast and pressure approaches hydrostatic, form deflection and leaks increase and lower layers cannot release air; too slow and colour lines may form between layers. Vibration must drive bubbles up and out along the form face, but over-vibration floats paste up and sinks aggregate, giving different colours top and bottom, and a vibrator touching the facing scuffs the surface. ACI 347.3R uses surface void ratio as one of its classification criteria, and vibration is the key to controlling voids.
units.model: 牆長 12 m、厚 0.3 m，預拌車以 15 m³/h 供料時上升速度 = 15/(12×0.3) ≈ 4.17 m/h，遠高於模板設計所假設的 1.5 m/h；要維持 1.5 m/h，供料應限制為 1.5×12×0.3 = 5.4 m³/h，5.46 m 高的牆需約 3.6 h 完成。數值為教學假設。~For a wall 12 m long and 0.3 m thick, supplying 15 m³/h gives a rate of rise of 15/(12×0.3) ≈ 4.17 m/h, far above the 1.5 m/h assumed in the formwork design; holding 1.5 m/h limits supply to 1.5×12×0.3 = 5.4 m³/h, and a 5.46 m wall takes about 3.6 h. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 澆置計畫列出每道牆的上升速度上限、分層厚度、澆置點與振動棒插入間距，現場以時間與液面高度紀錄核對上升速度；樣板牆上試驗振搗時間與插入方式，並以相同人員與設備施作正式牆體。~The placing plan lists maximum rate of rise, layer thickness, pour points and vibrator spacing for each wall, and the site checks rate of rise from time and level records; trial vibration time and technique on the mock-up and use the same crew and equipment for the real walls.
units.failure: 為趕在下班前完成而加快供料，上升速度倍增，模板鼓脹、拼縫漏漿，牆面下半部出現大量氣泡孔；振動棒在模板面附近反覆拖動，表面留下弧形磨痕與砂紋。~Speeding up supply to finish before the end of shift doubles the rate of rise, bulging the forms and leaking at joints, and leaves many bugholes on the lower half of the wall; dragging the vibrator back and forth near the facing leaves arc-shaped scuff marks and sand streaks.
units.misconception: 清水混凝土澆得越快越連續，表面就越均勻。~The faster and more continuously exposed concrete is placed, the more uniform the surface.
units.practice: 清水牆澆置由經過樣板訓練的固定班組執行，並安排專人控制供料節奏與記錄上升速度；澆置前在交底會議說明振動棒操作規則（垂直插入、不碰模板、規定停留時間）。~Have exposed walls placed by a fixed crew trained on the mock-up, with a person assigned to pace supply and log the rate of rise; brief the vibrator rules at the pre-pour meeting: insert vertically, never touch the facing, hold for the specified time.

units.anchor: 樣板牆與觀看距離~Mock-up and viewing distance
units.title: 樣板牆、比對基準與驗收距離~Mock-up, reference standard and viewing distance
units.mechanism: 清水混凝土的驗收離不開樣板牆。ACI 347.3R 把樣板定義為依契約文件製作的構件樣本，用來建立預期的表面完成度；它同時驗證模板、配比、脫模劑、澆置與振搗的組合，並成為整個工程的比對基準。樣板牆應包含真實的拼縫、繫桿孔、轉角、施工縫與開口邊緣，並在與正式工程相同的季節與條件下製作。驗收時還必須規定觀看距離與光線條件：同一面牆在 1 m 與 10 m 外看，可接受的缺陷完全不同。~Acceptance of exposed concrete depends on the mock-up. ACI 347.3R defines a mock-up as a sample of a building component made as specified in the contract documents to establish the expected surface finish; it proves the combination of forms, mix, release agent, placing and vibration and becomes the reference for the whole job. A mock-up should include real panel joints, tie holes, a corner, a construction joint and an opening edge, and be cast in the same season and conditions as the work. Acceptance must also state viewing distance and light: the same wall seen from 1 m and from 10 m tolerates entirely different defects.
units.model: 人眼解析度約 1 角分，觀看距離 d 時可分辨尺寸 ≈ d·tan(1/60°)。d = 6 m 時約 6,000×0.000291 ≈ 1.75 mm，表示 1 mm 以下的小氣孔在 6 m 外幾乎看不見；若改為 1 m 近看，可分辨約 0.29 mm，驗收結果會完全不同。數值為教學假設。~Human visual resolution is about one arc-minute, so the resolvable size at distance d is about d·tan(1/60°). At d = 6 m that is about 6,000×0.000291 ≈ 1.75 mm, so bugholes under 1 mm are almost invisible from 6 m; from 1 m about 0.29 mm can be resolved and the acceptance outcome changes completely. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 樣板牆完成後由業主、建築師、結構工程師與承包商在規定距離與自然光下共同檢視並書面核定，拍照存檔；正式工程驗收時在相同距離與光線下與樣板牆並列比較，爭議部分以檢查框量測孔洞比例與色差。~Once the mock-up is complete, owner, architect, structural engineer and contractor inspect it together at the specified distance in daylight, approve it in writing and photograph it; at acceptance compare the work side by side with the mock-up at the same distance and light, settling disputes with void-ratio and colour measurements in an inspection frame.
units.failure: 樣板牆只做一片光滑小面，沒有拼縫、繫桿孔或施工縫，正式工程出現的問題在樣板上從未被驗證；未約定觀看距離，業主以手電筒貼近檢查每一個小孔，導致無止境的修補要求。~A mock-up that is only a small smooth panel without joints, tie holes or construction joints never tests the problems that appear on the real work; with no agreed viewing distance, the owner inspects every pinhole with a torch at close range and repair demands never end.
units.misconception: 樣板牆只是給業主看的展示品，正式施工時不需要再參照。~The mock-up is just a showpiece for the owner and need not be referred to during construction.
units.practice: 樣板牆要在正式澆置前完成並核定，列為開工停檢點，且在工程期間保留在現場作為比對基準；契約中寫明驗收距離、光線條件、檢查框方法與可接受的修補範圍。~Complete and approve the mock-up before production casting as a hold point, keep it on site throughout the job as the reference, and write viewing distance, lighting, inspection-frame method and acceptable repair scope into the contract.

units.anchor: 表面亮度與色差量測~Surface lightness and colour measurement
units.title: 色差、平整度與孔洞的量化檢測~Quantifying colour, flatness and voids
units.mechanism: 清水混凝土的驗收若只靠主觀印象，很容易產生爭議，因此應盡量把外觀指標量化：以色差儀或標準灰卡量測表面明度與色差，以直尺或數位平整度儀量測平整度，以檢查框與影像分析量測孔洞比例。量測要在混凝土乾燥程度相近時進行，因為潮濕表面顏色較深；同一面牆的量測點應涵蓋不同澆置批次與樓層，才能看出系統性的變化。這些數據也能回饋到施工，例如發現下層顏色偏深時檢討振搗與漿體上浮。~Acceptance by subjective impression alone invites disputes, so appearance criteria should be quantified where possible: measure surface lightness and colour difference with a colorimeter or standard grey cards, flatness with a straightedge or digital flatness gauge, and void ratio with an inspection frame and image analysis. Measure when the concrete is similarly dry, because damp surfaces look darker, and spread points on each wall across different batches and storeys to reveal systematic changes. The data also feed back into construction; for example, a darker lower zone prompts a review of vibration and paste flotation.
units.model: 以 L*（明度）比較：樣板牆平均 L* = 65.0，某面牆平均 62.0，ΔL* = 3.0，超過假設容許值 ±2.0，需檢討原因；若同一面牆內最高與最低區塊相差 ΔL* = 1.2，則屬可接受的自然變化。平整度：3 m 直尺下最大間隙 3 mm，相當於 1/1,000。數值為教學假設。~Compare lightness L*: the mock-up averages L* = 65.0 and a wall averages 62.0, ΔL* = 3.0, beyond an assumed tolerance of ±2.0, so the cause must be investigated; a spread of ΔL* = 1.2 between the lightest and darkest zones within one wall counts as acceptable natural variation. Flatness: a maximum gap of 3 mm under a 3 m straightedge is 1/1,000. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 量測計畫規定儀器、校正方式、量測時機（例如拆模後 28 天、表面乾燥）、點位密度與紀錄格式；同一儀器與操作者量測樣板牆與正式牆體，結果以面板編號與澆置批次整理。~The measurement plan specifies instruments, calibration, timing (for example 28 days after stripping with a dry surface), point density and record format; measure mock-up and production walls with the same instrument and operator and organise results by panel number and pour batch.
units.failure: 拆模後第二天就在潮濕表面量色差，數據與日後乾燥後完全不同，據此要求的修補反而造成新的色斑；量測點只選在明顯缺陷處，無法代表整面牆，引發不必要的整面處理。~Measuring colour on a damp surface the day after stripping gives data unlike the dry surface later, and repairs ordered on that basis create new blotches; choosing points only at obvious defects does not represent the wall and triggers unnecessary whole-face treatment.
units.misconception: 清水混凝土的外觀好壞只能靠主觀感覺判斷，無法量測。~The appearance of exposed concrete can only be judged subjectively and cannot be measured.
units.practice: 在契約中明訂外觀量測方法、時機與允收值，並約定量測不合格時的處理順序：先比對樣板、再評估是否為可接受的自然變化、最後才決定修補；修補方法本身也要先在樣板牆上試做。~Specify appearance measurement methods, timing and acceptance values in the contract and agree the sequence for failures: compare with the mock-up, assess whether it is acceptable natural variation, and only then decide on repair, with any repair method trialled first on the mock-up.

units.anchor: 撥水保護與修補~Water-repellent protection and repair
units.title: 表面保護、污染與修補~Surface protection, soiling and repair
units.mechanism: 清水混凝土沒有塗裝保護，表面毛細孔會吸水，雨水帶著灰塵與微生物進入表層，形成流痕與黑斑；吸水也會加速凍融、碳化與鋼筋鏽蝕。常見作法是在完工後施作滲透型撥水劑（如矽烷或矽氧烷），降低表面吸水但不改變外觀與透氣性。修補是清水混凝土最難的工作：修補砂漿必須與周圍顏色、質感一致，而且新舊材料的顏色會隨時間以不同速度變化，所以修補配方要在樣板牆上試驗並放置一段時間觀察。~Exposed concrete has no paint, so surface capillaries absorb water and rain carries dust and micro-organisms into the surface layer, forming streaks and dark patches; absorption also accelerates freeze–thaw, carbonation and bar corrosion. A common measure is a penetrating water repellent such as silane or siloxane after completion, reducing absorption without changing appearance or breathability. Repair is the hardest job in exposed concrete: repair mortar must match the surrounding colour and texture, and new and old materials change colour at different rates over time, so repair recipes are trialled on the mock-up and left to weather before use.
units.model: 毛細吸水量 W = w·√t。未處理表面 w = 1.0 kg/m²·h^0.5，4 h 降雨吸水 W = 1.0×√4 = 2.0 kg/m²；以撥水劑降到 w = 0.1 時 W = 0.2 kg/m²，吸水減少 90%，表面污染與凍融風險隨之降低。數值為教學假設。~Capillary uptake W = w·√t. For an untreated surface with w = 1.0 kg/m²·h^0.5, four hours of rain absorb W = 1.0×√4 = 2.0 kg/m²; a water repellent that cuts w to 0.1 gives W = 0.2 kg/m², a 90% reduction with correspondingly less soiling and freeze–thaw risk. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 撥水劑施作前在樣板牆上試驗外觀是否改變，施作後以卡斯頓管（Karsten tube）或吸水試驗比較處理前後的吸水量；修補配方在樣板牆上試做並至少觀察數週至數月的顏色變化，再核定使用。~Before applying a repellent, trial it on the mock-up for any change in appearance, and afterwards compare water uptake before and after with Karsten tubes or absorption tests; trial repair recipes on the mock-up and watch colour change for at least several weeks to months before approval.
units.failure: 使用成膜型塗料代替滲透型撥水劑，表面變亮且逐年黃化、剝落，清水質感消失；修補砂漿當下顏色相近，一年後明顯偏白或偏深，整面牆布滿補丁。~Using a film-forming coating instead of a penetrating repellent makes the surface glossy, yellows and peels over the years and destroys the exposed-concrete texture; repair mortar that matches on the day turns noticeably lighter or darker a year later, leaving the wall covered in patches.
units.misconception: 清水混凝土很耐久，不需要任何表面保護與修補計畫。~Exposed concrete is durable and needs no surface protection or repair plan.
units.practice: 完工前應決定是否施作撥水劑、產品類型與重塗週期，並在樣板牆上核定；修補程序須規定誰可修補、修補範圍上限、配方與試做，並保存修補位置紀錄供日後維護比對。~Decide before completion whether to apply a repellent, which type and how often to recoat, approved on the mock-up; the repair procedure should state who may repair, the maximum repair extent, recipes and trials, and keep a record of repair locations for later maintenance.

units.anchor: 維護手冊與修補樣本~Maintenance manual and repair samples
units.title: 清潔、修補樣本與長期外觀管理~Cleaning, repair samples and long-term appearance
units.mechanism: 清水混凝土的外觀會隨時間演變：表面碳化使顏色略變，雨水流路形成污痕，綠藻在背陽面生長，繫桿孔塞頭可能鬆脫。沙克研究所於 1991 年被指定為歷史地標，其混凝土與柚木的保存工作顯示，清水建築的維護需要了解原始材料與工法。交接時應移交原配比、面材與脫模劑資料、撥水劑產品與施作紀錄、修補配方與樣本、樣板牆照片與量測基準，並規定可接受的清潔方法；高壓水柱或酸洗會改變表面質感，必須先試驗。~Exposed concrete changes with time: surface carbonation shifts colour slightly, rain paths form streaks, algae grow on shaded faces and tie-hole plugs may loosen. The Salk Institute, designated a historic landmark in 1991, shows through its concrete and teak conservation work that maintaining exposed buildings requires knowing the original materials and methods. Handover should deliver the original mix, facing and release-agent data, water-repellent product and application records, repair recipes and samples, mock-up photographs and measurement baselines, and specify acceptable cleaning methods; high-pressure water or acid washing changes surface texture and must be trialled first.
units.model: 撥水劑用量 0.3 L/m²，清水面 2,400 m² 每次約 2,400×0.3 = 720 L；若每 12 年重塗一次，50 年內約 4 次，共約 2,880 L。把用量、施作日期與吸水試驗結果列入維護資料庫，可判斷實際重塗時機是否需要提前。數值為教學假設。~At 0.3 L/m², 2,400 m² of exposed surface needs about 2,400×0.3 = 720 L per application; recoating every 12 years means about 4 applications and 2,880 L over 50 years. Recording quantities, dates and absorption-test results in a maintenance database shows whether recoating should come sooner. Values are teaching assumptions.
units.verify: 維護計畫規定定期目視檢查（污痕、藻類、裂縫、塞頭）、吸水試驗與色差量測，並與交接時的基準照片與數據比較；任何清潔或修補在不顯眼位置先試做，經建築師或維護顧問核可後才施作。~The maintenance plan sets periodic visual inspections for streaks, algae, cracks and plugs, absorption tests and colour measurements, compared with handover baseline photographs and data; trial any cleaning or repair in an inconspicuous spot and proceed only with approval from the architect or a conservation adviser.
units.failure: 管理單位為去除污痕以高壓水柱或強酸清洗，表面漿體被沖蝕，骨材外露，與未清洗區形成永久差異；缺少原始配比與修補樣本，後來的修補只能憑感覺調色，越補越明顯。~An owner who removes streaks with high-pressure water or strong acid erodes the surface paste and exposes aggregate, leaving a permanent difference from unwashed areas; without the original mix and repair samples, later repairs are colour-matched by guesswork and become ever more obvious.
units.misconception: 清水混凝土弄髒了用高壓水柱沖洗就能恢復原貌。~Dirty exposed concrete can be restored to its original look by pressure washing.
units.practice: 交接文件應包含清水面位置圖、材料與配比資料、撥水劑與修補紀錄、修補樣本與樣板牆照片、允許與禁止的清潔方法；重大清潔或修補應由熟悉清水混凝土的顧問評估並先試做。~Handover should include a map of exposed faces, material and mix data, repellent and repair records, repair samples and mock-up photographs, and permitted and prohibited cleaning methods; major cleaning or repair should be assessed by a consultant experienced in exposed concrete and trialled first.

example: 施工規劃練習：一道清水牆長 12 m、高 5.46 m、厚 0.3 m，要求 CSC4 級。模板以 0.91×1.82 m 面板分割，12/0.91 ≈ 13.2 片不是整數，改用 13 片、每片 12/13 ≈ 0.923 m 的訂製寬度，高度 3 片，共 39 片，每片 6 個繫桿孔共 234 個。面板 21 mm 合板，設計側壓 50 kPa，背楞間距 250 mm 時撓度 ≈ 0.47 mm（約 L/531），滿足 L/400。牆體體積 12×5.46×0.3 ≈ 19.7 m³，上升速度限制 1.5 m/h 時供料 5.4 m³/h，約 3.6 h 完成。驗收距離訂為 6 m，可分辨約 1.75 mm 的缺陷。若現場改以 15 m³/h 供料，上升速度變為約 4.17 m/h，整面牆約 1.3 h 澆完，側壓接近液壓 24×5.46 ≈ 131 kPa，為設計值的約 2.6 倍，面板撓度增為約 1.23 mm，超過 L/400 的 0.625 mm，牆面會出現可見波浪與漏漿痕。數值為教學假設，不代表任何實際建築。~Planning exercise: an exposed wall 12 m long, 5.46 m high and 0.3 m thick is specified to CSC4. With 0.91×1.82 m panels, 12/0.91 ≈ 13.2 is not a whole number, so 13 custom panels of 12/13 ≈ 0.923 m are used, three high, 39 panels in all with 6 tie holes each, 234 tie holes. With 21 mm plywood, a design pressure of 50 kPa and studs at 250 mm, deflection is about 0.47 mm (about L/531), meeting L/400. The wall holds 12×5.46×0.3 ≈ 19.7 m³; limiting the rate of rise to 1.5 m/h means 5.4 m³/h of supply and about 3.6 h to complete. Viewing distance is set at 6 m, where about 1.75 mm defects can be resolved. If the site switches to 15 m³/h, the rate of rise becomes about 4.17 m/h and the wall fills in about 1.3 h, pressure approaches hydrostatic 24×5.46 ≈ 131 kPa, about 2.6 times the design value, and facing deflection grows to about 1.23 mm, beyond the 0.625 mm L/400 limit, so visible waves and leak marks appear. Values are teaching assumptions, not any real building.
history: 路易斯．康設計的沙克研究所於 1962 年 6 月動工、同年 12 月開始澆置混凝土，1967 年完工，以含火山灰的暖色混凝土與規則的模板痕跡成為清水混凝土的經典，1991 年被指定為歷史地標。安藤忠雄的光之教會於 1989 年在大阪茨木完成，以規則的模板分割與繫桿孔和牆上的十字光縫聞名，1999 年增建主日學校。ACI 347.3R 在 2014 年初版印行，把成形混凝土表面分為 CSC1 至 CSC4 四級；ACI 301-20 第 6 節則規定契約指定時適用的建築混凝土要求。本課只重建公開原理與工程邏輯，不代表任何專案的設計文件。~Louis Kahn's Salk Institute broke ground in June 1962, began placing concrete that December and was completed in 1967; its warm-toned concrete containing volcanic ash and orderly form marks made it a classic of exposed concrete, and it was designated a historic landmark in 1991. Tadao Ando's Church of the Light was completed in Ibaraki, Osaka in 1989, known for its regular panel layout, tie holes and the cross-shaped slit of light in its wall, and a Sunday school was added in 1999. ACI 347.3R was first printed in 2014, dividing formed concrete surfaces into four categories, CSC1 to CSC4, while ACI 301-20 Section 6 sets architectural-concrete requirements that apply when the contract designates them. This course reconstructs public principles and engineering logic only, not any project's design documents.
facts: ACI 347.3R 把成形混凝土表面分為 CSC1 至 CSC4 共 4 級，CSC4 用於紀念性或地標建築~ACI 347.3R divides formed concrete surfaces into 4 categories, CSC1 to CSC4, with CSC4 for monumental or landmark structures
ACI 301-20 第 6 節建築混凝土只有在契約文件指定時才適用~ACI 301-20 Section 6 Architectural Concrete applies only when designated in the contract documents
沙克研究所 1962 年 6 月動工、12 月開始澆置混凝土，1967 年完工~The Salk Institute broke ground in June 1962, began placing concrete in December 1962 and was completed in 1967
沙克研究所基地約 27 英畝，原始建築於 1991 年被指定為歷史地標~The Salk Institute site is about 27 acres, and the original buildings were designated a historic landmark in 1991
